violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: QUINOA AT 54F, HOLLANDAISE SAUCE AT 59F, BREAKFAST SAUSAGE AT 56F, CHIA AT 56F, PRECOOKED BARBACOA AT 54F, SMOKED SALMON AT 59F ON RACK OUTSIDE WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO RETURN FOODS TO REFRIGERATION FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW. PIC TRANSFERRED FOODS TO ICE BATHS UNTIL WIC WAS AVAILABLE TO STORE FOODS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: PRECOOKED BEEF THAWING IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO EITHER THAW UNDER REFRIGERATION OR SUBMERGED IN RUNNING WATER. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the HANDWASH SINK AT RIGHT OF DISHWASHER piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE REPAIR. FIRST WATCH RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 03/13/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: GLASSWARE, FOOD CONTAINERS AND TABLEWARE BEING CLEANED IN CHEMICAL DISHWASHING MACHINE WITH CHLORINE SANITIZER AT 0PPM.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SET UP 3 COMPARTMENT SINK SANITIZER BASIN WITH SANITIZER OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION FOR SANITIZING DISHES AFTER WASHING AND RINSING WITH DISHWASHING MACHINE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE DISHES ARE MANUALLY SANITIZED UNTIL DISHWASHING MACHINE IS REPAIRED AND CAN SANITIZE AT 50-200PPM CHLORINE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: SANITIZER DISPENSER AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK DISPENSING QUATERNARY AMMONIA AT LESS THAN 100PPM DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO MANUALLY ADJUST SANITIZER SOLUTION TO 200-400 PPM AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK UNTIL UNIT IS REPAIRED AND CAN DISPENSE SANITIZER AT APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATIONS. EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT IS REPAIRED. FIRST WATCH RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 09/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WRAPPING CLEAN UTENSILS WITHOUT WEARING GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE UTENSILS CLEANED AND SANITIZED BEFORE RE-WRAPPING WITH GLOVED HANDS TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: KAIRAK 3 DOOR PREP TOP AT 44/46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC INDICATED FOODS WERE BEING KEPT ON TIME AND IN ICE BATHS DURING SERVICE PERIOD. PLEASE DO NOT STORE FOODS IN UNIT OVERNIGHT OR FOR ANY PERIOD BEYOND 4 HOURS DURING THE DAY UNTIL REFRIGERATOR IS SERVICED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. INFORM EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.
